toc.title: Summaria descriptio privati colloquii, quod ego Casparus Vlenbergius Lippiensis, Pastor & Canonicus ad D. Cunibertum

book: A single 1590 Latin work printed in Cologne: Caspar Vlenbergius's account of a private colloquy with the Calvinist minister Johannes Badius, held on 10 and 11 April 1590. It has title pages, a dedication to the reader, and a summary heading followed by two day-sections (collationes), and the sheet repeats the text from scan 26 as a second copy.
